Title: Azure Monitor for Containers agent updates

Body.Content:
We have released the 11/29/2018 build version of the Azure Monitor for Containers agent. Some of the enhancements include:

  • New auto-upgrade feature for the agent. 
  • Option to disable collection of environment variables from containers.
  • Data collection bug fixes. 

For more information about the enhancements, see the agent release notes. For more information about managing the agent, see the documentation.
